title: Recovered a delayed launch
situation: A key launch was slipping because multiple teams had conflicting priorities.
task: Create a realistic recovery plan without reducing the critical scope.
action: Aligned teams around milestones, removed low-value work, and established twice-weekly risk reviews.
result: The launch shipped within the revised window and reduced unresolved dependencies.

title: Changed a decision with data
situation: The team wanted to prioritize a feature based mainly on stakeholder requests.
task: Determine whether the feature would actually create meaningful customer value.
action: Analyzed usage patterns, interviewed customers, and compared the opportunity with competing priorities.
result: The team changed direction and focused on a higher-impact initiative.
